details.body: Quack, s. kuvEdyaH, dAMBikaH, CadmavEdyaH, mi-TyAcikitsakaH. 2 haMsanAdaH-ravaH. v. t. haMsavat nad 1 P or ru 2 P. [Quack]ery, s. duSci-kitsA; miTyABimAnaH. 2 Boast, q. v.
QUACK (subs.): I Medical:(1) kuvEdyaH, Sr. i. 5. ch.;(2) miTyAcikitsakaH; and sim. comp.s.II A mountebank: perh.: (1) miTyABimAnin (f. nI);(2) dAmBikaH: v. Impostor.III Of ducks: praRAdaH: v. Noise.
QUACK (v.): I To act as a q.: expr. by subs.II To brag, boast: q. v.: miTyABimAnaM karoti.III As. a duck: praRadati (nad, c. 1.): v. Noise, to make; cry.

QUACK , s. (Cry of a duck or goose) haMsanAdaH, haMsarAvaH, haMsacI- tkAraH, kvakaSabdaH. — (Empiric, pretender to medical skill) duSci- kitsakaH, miTyAcikitsakaH, miTyAvEdyaH, CadmavEdyaH, vEdyammanyaH, vEdyaBAnI m. (n), AyurvedAnaBijYaH.

To QUACK , v. n. haMsavad nad (c. 1. nadati -dituM) or ru (c. 2. rOti, ravituM) or cItkf or kf, haMsanAdaM kf, kvak SabdaM kf. — (Pretend to medical skill) duScikitsAM kf, miTyAcikitsanaM kf, AyurvedaviroDena cikitsAM kf.
QUACKERY: (1) duScikitsA and sim. comp.s.; (2) miTyABimAnaH: v. Imposture, boasting.
QUACKERY , s. duScikitsA -tsanaM, miTyAcikitsA -tsanaM, AyurvedavirudDA cikitsA, AyurvedAnaBijYatA.
QUACKISH: (1) miTyABimAnin (f. nI);(2) dAmBika (f. kI).
QUADRAGESIMA: catvAriMSaddinopavAsaH and sim. comp.s. (?).
QUADRAGESIMA , s. catvAriMSaddivasopavAsaH, catvAriMSaddinopavAsaH.
QUADRAGESIMAL , a. catvAriMSaddinopavAsasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
Quadrangle, s. caturBujaH, catuzkoRaH; (of a house) prakozWaH, catvaraM, saMjavanaM, catuH-SAlaM. Quadrangular, a. catuzkoRa, caturasra.
QUADRANGLE: I Lit.:(1) caturasram;(2) caturBujaH.II Of a house: catvaram (= court).
QUADRANGLE , s. caturasraM, catuzkoRaH, caturBujaH; ‘formed by four houses,’ catuHSAlaM -lA -lakaM, catuSSAlA, prakozWaH.
QUADRANGULAR: (1) caturasra (f. srA);(2) catuzkoRa (f. RA).
QUADRANGULAR , a. catuzkoRaH -RA -RaM, caturasraH -srA -sraM, caturBujaH -jA -jaM.
Quadrant, s. caturTaBAgaH, pAdaH. 2 vfttapAdaH.
QUADRANT: I A quarter: q. v.: pAdaH.II Of a circle:(1) vfttapAdaH;(2) padam (rare), Su. ii. 30.III An instrument: vfttapAda- yantram.
QUADRANT , s. (Fourth part) pAdaH, caturTaBAgaH, turIyaBAgaH. — (Of a circle) varttulapAdaH, trijyA, padaM. — (The instrument) turIyayantraM, sUryyayantraM.
Quadratic, a. caturasrIya. 2 (equation) vargasamIkaraRaM.
QUADRATIC: v. Square. Q. equation: varga- samIkaraRam.
QUADRATIC , c. catuzkoRIyaH -yA -yaM, vargIyaH -yA -yaM, caturasrIyaH &c.
Quadrature, s. padasaMsTAnaM.
QUADRATURE: in astro.: (pA)padasaMsTAnam (after pada of Su. ii. 30).
QUADRATURE , s. (Of a circle, &c.) vargIkaraRaM.
Quadrennial, a. cAturvArzika (kI f.).
QUADRENNIAL: (1) caturvArzika (f. kI);(2) cAturabdika (f. kI); etc.
QUADRENNIAL , a. caturvarzIyaH -yA -yaM, cAturvarzikaH -kI -kaM, cAturabdikaH &c.
Quadrilateral, a. caturBuja, catuHpArSva.
QUADRILATERAL: (1) caturBuja (f. jA);(2) caturasra (f. srA).
QUADRILATERAL , a. caturBujaH -jA -jaM, catuHpArSvIyaH -yA -yaM, catuHpArSvaH -rSvA -rSvaM, catuHpArSvayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, catuHpArSvaviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
QUADRILITERAL , a. caturakzaraH -rA -raM, caturvarRaH -rRA -rRaM.
QUADRILLE: I A game at cards: *cAtvAriMSam. II A dance: *caturasranftyam.
QUADRILLE , s. caturnftyaM, sammuKasTAnAM strIpuruzARAM nftyaM.
QUADRIMESTRAL , a. caturmAsyaH -syA -syaM, cAturmAsikaH -kI -kaM.
QUADRIPARTILE , a. caturviDaH -DA -DaM, caturBAgaH -gA -gaM, caturviBAgaH &c.
Quadripartite, a. caturviDa.
QUADRIPARTITE: caturBAgaviBakta (f. ktA) and sim. comp.s.
Quadrisyllable, s. caturakzaraM.
QUADRISYLLABLE: caturakzaram or caturakzaraH SabdaH (?).
QUADRISYLLABLE , s. caturakzaraM, caturakzaraviSizwaH SabdaH, caturakzaraH SabdaH.
QUADRIVIAL , a. catuzpaTIyaH -yA -yaM, caturmArgIyaH -yA -yaM.
QUADRIVIUM: I Of roads: catuzpaTam.II Of arts: caturvidyA.
QUADRIVIUM , s. (Place where four roads meet) catuzpaTaM, caturmArgaM.
QUADRUMANOUS: (1) catuzpARi (mfn.);(2) caturBujaH (jA, jaM).
Quadruped, s. catuzpadaH (dI f.), catuzpAd.
QUADRUPED , s. catuzpadaH -dI, catuzpAdaH, catuzpAd m. f. n., catuzpAdaH paSuH, catuzpadapaSuH m., catuzpadaprARI m. (n), caturgatiH -tiH -ti.
Quadruple, a. caturguRa. v. t. caturguRIkf 8 U.
QUADRUPLE: I Adj.: caturguRaH (RA, RaM).II Verb: caturguRaM (f. RAM) karoti.
QUADRUPLE , a. caturguRaH -RA -RaM, caturviDaH -DA -DaM, catuzwayaH -yI -yaM.
To QUADRUPLE , QUADRUPLICATE, v. a. caturguRaM -RAM kf, caturguRIkf. caturviDIkf.
QUADRUPLICATE: caturguRIkaroti; caturguRaM (f. RAM) karoti.
Quaff, v. t. (satfzRaM) pA 1 P, ut-culuMp 1 P. [Quaff]er, s. atipAyin m.
QUAFF: ut-culumpati (culump, c. 1.), Vi. v. 32.: v. To drink.
To QUAFF . v. a. bAhulyena pA (c. 1. pivati pAtuM) or ApA or nipA.
QUAFFED , p. p. pItaH -tA -taM, ApItaH -tA -taM, nizItaH -tA -taM.
QUAFFER: atipAyin (f. nI): v. Drinker.
QUAFFER , s. pAtA m. (tf), pAyI m. (n), atipAyI m., bahupAyI.
QUAGGA: *citragardaBaH.
QUAGGY , a. paNkilaH -lA -laM, paNkamayaH -yI -yaM, bahupaNkaH -NkA -NkaM.
QUAGMIRE: anupaBUH, -BUmiH: v. Fen, marsh.
QUAGMIRE , s. paNkaH, kupaNkaH, paNkilaBUH f., kArdamaBUmiH f., sapaNkaBUmiH f., paNkakarvawaH, anUpaBUH f., paNkasTAnaM.
Quail, s. vartakaH, vartikA, lAvaH. v. i. kaMp 1 A, vep 1 A. 2 vi-ava-sad 1 P, kzi pass.; pralI 4 A.
QUAIL (subs.): (1) vartakaH (perdix olivacea); (2) lavaH (p. chinensis).
QUAIL (v.): I Intrans: vizIdati (sad, c. 1.): v. To give way, tremble.II Trans: v. To quell.
To QUAIL , v. n. kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM), prakamp, vikamp, sad (c. 1. sIdati, satruM), avasad, vizad, kzi in pass. (kzIyate), pralI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM).
QUAIL , s. (The bird) varttikA, varttakaH, varttakapakzI m. (n), PaRisvelaH, gaYjikAyaH, lAvaH, lAvakaH, garudyoDI m. (n), BAratI, vizRuliNgI.
Quaint, a. aparUpa, vilakzaRa, asaMgata. 2 vi-dagDa, catura, atisUkzma. [Quaint]ly, adv. vilakzaRaM, asaMgataM.
QUAINT: I Odd, unusual: q. v.: aparUpa (f. pA).II Cunning, subtle: q. v.: vidagDa (f. gDA).
QUAINT , a. (Odd) vilakzaRaH -RA -RaM, asaNgataH -tA -taM, aparUpaH -pA -paM, prAcInarItyanurUpaH -pA -paM. — (Over exact) atisUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM.
QUAINTLY , adv. vilakzaRaM, vElakzaRyena, asaNgataM, prAcInarItyanurUpeRa.
QUAINTNESS: aparUpatA: v. Also strangeness.
QUAINTNESS , s. vElakzaRyaM, vilakzaRatA, asaNgatatvaM, aparUpatA, atisUkzmatA.
Quake, v. i. kaMp 1 A, udvij 6 A, tras 1, 4 P; (with abl.). s. kaMpaH-panaM, ut-pra-kaMpaH, vepaTuH.
QUAKE (v.): kampate, pra-, vi-, ut-, (kamp, c. 1.): v. To tremble, shudder.
QUAKE (subs.): kampaH, -nam, pra-, ut-; earth-q.: avaniprakampanam, Ku. xv. 23.: v. Also tremor, shudder.

To QUAKE , v. n. kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM), prakamp, vikamp, aBikamp, vep (c. 1. vepate -pituM), pravep, tras (c. 4. trasyati -situM), vitras, udvij (c. 6. -vijate -jituM), hval (c. 1. hvalati -lituM), vihval, prahval.
QUAKE , s. kampaH, prakampaH, utkampaH, kampanaM, vepanaM, pravepaRaM, vepaTuH m.
QUAKER: of the sect.: *bAnDavaH.
QUAKER , s. kampAnvitaH -tA, kampanaH -nA, kampamAnaH -nA, sakampaH.
QUAKING (adj.): (1) kampamAna (f. nA), pra-, ut-; (2) vepamAna (f. nA), Q. -grass: kampanA.
QUAKING , part. kampamAnaH -nA -naM, veyamAnaH -nA -naM, kampitaH -tA -taM.
QUALIFICATION: I The state of being quali- -fied: expr. by adj.: v. Qualified.II Endowment, excellency: q. v.: guRaHIII Condition, restriction: q. v.: niyamaH.

QUALIFICATION , s. (That which fits a person for any office, &c.) yogyatA, upayuktatA, upayogitA, kzamatA, kAryyakzamatA, guRaviSizwatA, guRavESizwyaM, guRatA. — (Endowment) guRaH, viSezaRaM. — (Modifica- tion, limitation) maryyAdA, niyamanaM, paricCedaH -danaM, avacCedaH -danaM, SamanaM, parimitatvaM, niyatatvaM, parimARaM, nyUnatvaM, nyUnIkaraRaM, viSezaH; ‘without qualification,’ aviSezaRaH -RA -RaM.

QUALIFIED (adj.): I Fit: q. v.:(1) yogya (f. gyA);(2) samarTa (f. rTa): v. Able;(3) guRo- peta (f. tA) and sim. comp.s. (= endowed with qualifications), first of all should wish (try) to be himself q.: AtmAnamevas praTamacCeguRa- samanvitam, Ka. iv. 3.II Competent: q. v.: (1) yogya (f. gyA);(2) not expr.III Li- -mited, restricted. expr. with subs. niyamaH etc.

QUALIFIED , p. p. (Fitted) yogyaH -gyA -gyaM, upayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, upayogI -ginI -gi (n), kzamaH -mA -maM, kAryyakzamaH -mA -maM, karmmakzamaH &c., alaNkarmIRaH -RA -RaM, ucitaH -tA -taM, paryAptaH -ptA -ptaM, guRavAn -vatI -vat (t), guRI &c., guRopetaH -tA -taM. — (Modified) niyamitaH -tA -taM, niyataH &c., nibadDaH -dDA -dDaM, samaryyAdaH -dA -daM, saparimARaH -RA -RaM, parimitaH -tA -taM, paricCinnaH -nnA -nnaM, SamitaH &c.

Qualify, v. t. yogya-ucita-kzama a. kf 8 U; ex. by ‘q(ualifi)ed’. 2 niyam 1 P, paricCid 7 P, pari-mA 3 A, 2 P, nibaMD 9 P. 3 Moderate, q. v. [Qualifi]ed, a. yogya, kzama, samarTa, paryApta, karmakzama, alaMkarmIRa. 2 guRin, guRopeta, guRasaMpanna. 3 niyata, paricCinna, samaryAda; See Limited. [Qualif]ication, s. yogyatA, kzamatA, pAtratA, OcityaM, guRavi-SizwatA. 2 guRaH, pAtratvaM, viSizwaguRaH. 3 paricCedaH, maryAdA, niyamanaM, niyatatvaM, pari-mARaM. Quality, s. guRaH. 2 BAvaH, DarmaH, guRaH, svaBAvaH, prakfti f.; sva-, rUpaM, lakzaRaM, viSezaBAvaH-DarmaH-lakzaRaM, SIlaM; Sakti f. 3 kulInatA, SrezWa-viSizwa-padaM, pratizWA, gOravaM, utkfzwapadaM. 4 prakAraH, jAti f.; See Kind; ‘good q(uality)’ guRaH, sadguRaH, sadBAvaH, ‘having good q(ualiti)es’ guRin, guRavat, guRopeta, guRa-yukta, sadguRa; ‘bad q(uality)’ durguRaH, avaguRaH; ‘inherent q(uality) of a thing’ nisargaDarmaH, vastuSaktiH; ‘men of q(uality)’ kulInajanAH, aBijAta-kulIna-vargaH.
QUALIFY: I To make qualified: yogyaM (f. gyAM) etc. karoti,: v. Fit. able, q.ied.II To modulate, vary: q. v.III To restrict., restrain: q. v.: niyacCati (yam, c. 1.).

To QUALIFY , v. a. (Make fit) yogyaM -gyAM kf, upayuktaM -ktAM kf, kzamaM -mAM kf, kAryyakzamaM -mAM kf, upayoginaM -ginIM kf, paryAptaM -ptAM kf, guRavantaM -vatIM kf, yogyIkf, kzamIkf, upayuktaguRAn dA. — (Modify, limit, diminish) niyam (c. 1. -yacCati -yantuM), nibanD (c. 9. -baDnAti -bandDuM), samaryyAdaM -dAM kf, parimA, parimitaM -tAM kf, saparimARaM -RAM kf, pariCid, Sam, upaSam, praSam, nyUnIkf, hras, lup.

QUALITY: I Property:(1) guRaH, the three q. ies.: triguRam, Ch.; not for specifying (your good) q.ies.: na guRAnAmiyattayA, R. x. 32.; attached on account of good q.ies: guRAnurakta (f. ttA), Ki. i. 31.;(2) DarmaH (not of good or bad q. ies.), in pleasures whose q. is evanescent: vizayezu vinASaDarmasu, R. viii. 10.; for the absence of personal q.ies.: puruzaDarmatvABAvAt S. p. b. 1. 52. II Rank, station: q. v.III People of rank;(1) kulInAH (m. pl.);(2) kOlinyam.

QUALITY , s. (Property) guRaH, DarmmaH; ‘good quality,’ sahuRaH, suguRaH, guRaH; ‘possessed of good qualities,’ sadguRaH -RA -RaM, guRI RinI -Ri (n), sadguRI &c., suguRI &c., guRavAn -vatI -vat (t), guRAnvitaH -tA -taM, guRopetaH -tA -taM, guRasAgaraH -rA -raM, guRAkaraH -rA -raM, guRayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, guRASrayaH -yA -yaM; ‘the possession of good qualities,’ guRatA, guRavattA; ‘destitute of them,’ guRahInaH -nA -naM; ‘the loss of them,’ guRaBraMSaH; ‘a collection or heap of them,’ guRasaMgrahaH, guROGaM, guRapUgaM; ‘variety of quality,’ guRAntaraM; ‘bad quality,’ durguRaH -RaM, avaguRaH, asadguRaH; ‘possessed of bad qualities,’ durguRI &c.; ‘essential or inherent quality,’ anuga- taDarmmaH, vastuSaktiH f. — (Distinguishing property) DarmmaH, BAvaH, svaBAvaH, viSezaguRaH, viSezaDarmmaH, viSezaH, lakzaRaM, guRalakzaRaM, svaBA- valakzaRaM, rUpaM, svarUpaM, SIlaH -laM. — (Nature, disposition) BAvaH, svaBAvaH, prakftiH f., SIlaH -latA; ‘good quality,’ sadBAvaH. — (Cha- racter, whether good or bad) BAvaH, sadasadBAvaH, guRAguRaM, guRA- vaguRaM, sattvaM, sattvAsattvaM. — (High rank) SrezWapadaM, padaSrezWatA utkfzwapadaM padotkfzwatA, kulInatA. — (People of rank) kulInavargaH, SrezWapada- sTAH m. pl., kulInajanAH m. pl. kOlInaM.
Qualm, s. vamanecCA, vivamizA. 2 manastApaH, anuSayaH, anutApaH. [Qualm]ish, a. vivamizu.
QUALM (subs.): I Of conscience: manastApaH and sim. comp.s.II Nausea:(1) vamanecCA; (2) vivamizA (rare.)
QUALM , s. (Nausea) vamanecCA, vivamipA, utkleSaH. — (Of conscience) manastApaH, antaHkaraRatApaH, IzattApaH, IzatsantApaH, paScAttApaH.
QUALMISH: (1) vamanaBAva (f. vA ?);(2) vivamizu (mfn.: ?).
QUALMISH , a. vamanecCuH -cCuH -cCu, vivamizuH &c., vamanonmuKaH -KA -KaM.
QUANDARY: saMSayaH v. Doubt, difficulty.
QUANDARY , s. sandehaH, saMSayaH, samBramaH, vyastatA, vyAmohaH.
QUANTITATIVE: parimARasUcaka (f. cikA) and sim. comp.s.

Quantity, s. parimARaM, pramARaM, mAnaM, mAtrA, aMSaH, BAgaH. 2 mAtrA. 3 rASiH. 4 (Large) saMcayaH, oGaH, pUgaH, puMjaH, rASiH, saMgrahaH; ‘a great q(uantity) of’ praBUta, pracura, bahu, vipula; ‘great q(uantity)’ bAhulyaM, prAcuryaM, bahuBAgaH, BU-yizWAMSaH; ex. by bahu, pracura, vipula (Much, q. v.); ‘in large q(uantiti)es’ bahuSaH, bAhulyena, prAcuryeRa; ‘small q(uantity)’ stokAMSaH, alpaBAgaH, alpaM, stokaM, alpamAtraM; ‘in small q(uantiti)es’ alpaSaH, stokAMSena; ‘long q(uantity)’ dIrGaH; ‘short q(uantity)’ hrasvaH; ‘known q(uantity)’ vyakta-rASiH; ‘unknown q(uantity)’ avyaktarASiH; ‘positive, negative, q(uantity)’ Dana-fRa-rASiH; ‘what q(uantity) of’ kiyat.

QUANTITY: I In gen.:(1) parimARam;(2) pramARam. Ph.: what q.: kiyat (f. tI): v. Much, how.; a great q. of: praBUta (f. tA): v. Abundant; a little q. of: alpa (f. lpA): v. Little; that q. which: yAvat (f. tI): v. Much, as-; in large q.ies: bahuSaH; in small q. alpaSaH.II In prosody: not expr., long q.: dIrGaH; short q.: hrasvaH.III In logic: aDikAraH (??).IV In Math.: unknown q.: avyakta- rASiH.

QUANTITY , s. (Magnitude, a mass or collection of indetermi- nate dimensions) parimARaM, pramARaM, parimitiH f., mAnaM, mAtrA, BAgaH, aMSaH; ‘a quantity of water equivalent to a piece of gold,’ suvarRaKaRqasamo or suvarRaKaRqaparimARo or suvarRaKaRqaparimito jalAMSaH. — (Great quantity, abundance) bAhulyaM, bahutvaM -tA, prAcuryyaM, pracuratA, prAyaH, ADikyaM, mahABAgaH or expressed by the adjec- tives bahu, pracura. aDika prefixed; ‘in great quantities,’ bAhu- lyena, bahuSas, anekaSasa, prAcuryyeRa. — (Great quantity, collec- tion) saYcayaH, nicayaH, pracayaH, sannayaH, vfndaM, oGaH, saMgrahaH puYjaH, [Page648-b+ 51] rASiH m., pUgaH, puNgaH -NgaM, nivahaH, vAraH. See HEAP. — (Small quantity) alpaBAgaH, alpAMSaH, alpaM -lpikA, alpamAtraM, mAtrA, stokaM, muzwimAtraM, muzwiparimARaM; ‘in small quantities,’ alpaSas, see LITTLE. — (Measure, in prosody) mAtrA. — (In arithmetic or algebra) rASiH m. f.; ‘known quantity,’ vyaktarASiH m. f., rUpaM; ‘unknown quantity,’ avyaktarASiH, avyaktaH; ‘negative,’ kzayaH; ‘infinite,’ anantarASiH; ‘figurative,’ kzetrarASiH.
Quantum, s. parimARaM, mAtrA, kalpitaBAgaH.
QUANTUM , s. parimARaM, nirUpitAMSaH, nirUpitaBAgaH, upayuktaBAgaH.
Quarantine, s. gamanAgamana-saMsarga-nizeDaH.
QUARANTINE: gamanAgamana- or saMsarga- pratizeDaH (??).
QUARANTINE , s. catvAriMSaddinaparyyantaM gamanAgamananizeDaH or saMsarganizeDaH, catvAriMSaddivasaparyyantaM gamanAgamanAvaroDaH.

Quarrel, s. kalahaH, kaliH, vivAdaH, visaM-vAda, vipratipatti f., vAkkalahaH, vAgyudDa, vipralApaH; dvaMdvaM, vEraM. v. i. vivad 1 A, vipralap 1 P, visaMvad 1 P, vipratipad 4 A, vErAyate-kalahAyate (D.), kalahaM kf 8 U, yuD 4 A. [Quarrel]er, s. vivAdin m., kalahakArI. [Quarrel]some, a. kalaha-kali-priya, vivAdaSIla, visaMvAdin, kalaha-kali-para, kalahakArin, yuyutsu, vivAdArTin.
QUARREL (subs.): (1) kalahaH, affected q.: kfta- kakalahaH, Mu. iii.; in (our) q.: kalahe, Vi. ii. 34.;(2) vivAdaH: v. Dispute.;(3) kaliH (rare.)
QUARREL (v.): (1) kalahaM karoti;(2) kalahAyate (nomi.), C. i.;(3) vivAdaM karoti: v. Also to dispute, abuse.

QUARREL , s. vivAdaH, kalahaH -haM, vAgyudDaM, vAkkalahaH -haM, vAdayudDaM, vipra- lApaH, vAkkaliH m., visaMvAdaH, viprayogaH, vipratipattiH f., dvandvaM, dvEDaM, viroDoktiH f., vAgviroDaH, mEtrIBaNgaH, sOhfdaBaNgaH, vEraM, vEritA; ‘quarrel in fun,’ krIqAkalahaH.

To QUARREL , v. n. kalahaM kf, kalaha (nom. kalahAyate), vivad (c. 1. -vadate -dituM), visaMvad, vipralap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), vyavakruS (c. 1. -kroSati -krozwuM), vAkkalahaM kf, vAgyudDaM kf, yuD (c. 4. yuDyate, yodDuM), vEra (nom. vErAyate), dvandvaM kf.
QUARRELER , s. vivAdI m. (n), kalahakArI m. (n), kalikArakaH.
QUARRELING , s. kalahakaraRaM, vivAdakaraRaM, vyavakroSanaM, kalkanaM.
QUARRELLER: kalahakArin (f. RI): v. Also quarrelsome.
